令和９(2027)年度 東京大学大学院工学系研究科 修士課程・博士後期課程
【出願日程Ｂ】（冬入試）学生募集について
今年度は以下の専攻において、【出願日程Ｂ】（冬入試）の学生募集を行います。
〇令和９(2027)年度修士課程【出願日程Ｂ】実施専攻：
原子力国際専攻
〇令和９(2027)年度博士後期課程【出願日程Ｂ】実施専攻：
機械工学専攻、精密工学専攻、電気系工学専攻、応用化学専攻、
化学システム工学専攻、先端学際工学専攻、原子力国際専攻
〇学生募集要項
修士課程・博士後期課程
https://www.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/study-at-utokyo/soe/apply/guideline#guidelines
原子力国際専攻 の【出願日程Ｂ】に関する専攻入試案内は、10 月下旬に公開予定です。外国語試
験(英語)及び TOEFL スコア提出期限は、専攻入試案内を確認してください。
その他の専攻は、本研究科ウェブサイトに４月３日公開済みの専攻入試案内をご確認ください。
Graduate School of Engineering, The University of Tokyo
2027 Master's and Doctoral Program Entrance Examinations
～Application Schedule B (Winter Exam)～
This year, the Graduate School of Engineering will conduct the “Application Schedule B（Winter
Exam）” entrance examinations for the following departments.
〇Application Schedule B for the 2027 Master’s Program:
Department of Nuclear Engineering and Management
〇Application Schedule B for the 2027 Doctoral Program:
Department of Mechanical Engineering,
Department of Precision Engineering,
Department of Electrical Engineering and Information Systems,
Department of Applied Chemistry,
Department of Chemical System Engineering，
Department of Advanced Interdisciplinary Studies.
Department of Nuclear Engineering and Management
〇The “Guidelines for Applicants”
Master's and Doctoral Program
https://www.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/en/study-at-utokyo/soe/apply/guideline#guidelines
The “Guide to Entrance Examinations” for the Department of Nuclear Engineering and
Management for Application Schedule B is scheduled to be published in late October. Please refer to
the “Guide to Entrance Examinations” for details regarding the deadlines for the Foreign Language
(English) examinations and TOEFL score submission.
For the other departments, please refer to the “Guide to Entrance Examinations” on our website,
already released on April 3.
